author: ahnyoung-paul
title: Debian Packages job fails - apt-get cannot reach azure.archive.ubuntu.com (connection timed out)
signature: Could not connect to azure.archive.ubuntu.com connection timed out|Network

failed_jobs.name: Debian Packages / Debian Packages
failed_jobs.symptom: apt-get fails to fetch packages from azure.archive.ubuntu.com with connection timeout

key_errors: E: Failed to fetch http://azure.archive.ubuntu.com/ubuntu/pool/main/p/python3.10/libpython3.10-minimal_3.10.12-1~22.04.16_amd64.deb  Could not connect to azure.archive.ubuntu.com:80 (52.161.185.214), connection timed out

E: Failed to fetch http://azure.archive.ubuntu.com/ubuntu/pool/main/e/expat/libexpat1_2.4.7-1ubuntu0.7_amd64.deb  Could not connect to azure.archive.ubuntu.com:80 (52.250.76.244), connection timed out
root_cause: The GitHub Actions runner could not connect to azure.archive.ubuntu.com:80 (the Ubuntu apt mirror used in Azure), resulting in connection timeouts when fetching Debian packages during the apt-get install step. This is a transient network/infrastructure issue unrelated to the PR changes.
reproduction_steps: N/A - infrastructure/network issue not reproducible locally
recommended_actions: Retry the failed jobs - this is a transient network issue
If persistent, check Azure network status or switch to alternative apt mirrors
prevention_strategies: Consider retrying apt-get operations with retry logic in workflow scripts or using an apt mirror fallback.
historical_context: This exact pattern has been seen 5 times since 2026-08-18, all failing with identical connection timeouts to azure.archive.ubuntu.com:80.
